messages:
mira: Heads-up: starting a refactor proposal to merge the 'smokehouse' bench and runtime preflight into a single 'smokebridge' runner. Want to discuss tradeoffs re: sampling, kv-cache, and quantized artifacts.

sam: SG. What's the primary goal? speed of admit vs. stronger validation?

mira: Primary: reduce duplicate work and flakiness. Current flow runs small bench then runtime smoke separately -> double uploads, different input sampling, mismatch in prefixes.

jordan: I like that. Danger: coupling could increase false positives if bench and runtime share same infra. Need isolation modes.

lee: Tradeoffs: we can share golden inputs and sample generation but run execution on separate sandboxes (bench VM vs runtime GPU). That keeps signal aligned.

mira: Proposed interface: artifact includes metadata with fingerprints + 'execution_hint': 'cpu_sim'|'gpu_real' + 'kv_cache_expected': true/false.

sam: Can you paste example metadata?

mira: ```json
{
  "model_name": "gpt-small-v1",
  "artifact_sha256": "abc123def456...",
  "quantized": "int8",
  "fingerprint": "fp:2026-03-01:abcd",
  "execution_hint": "gpu_real",
  "kv_cache_expected": "128MiB",
  "smoke_seed_inputs": ["golds/a1.txt", "golds/a2.txt"],
  "bench_profile": "latency: p95=120ms"
}
```

jordan: kv_cache_expected as size is good. Also include 'kv_prefix_policy' to assert prefix caching behavior (e.g. prefix-only vs full-kv).

lee: For compatibility checks, two-stage: (1) lightweight quick-check that validates signatures & tensor shapes, (2) smokebridge full exec w/ cached KV toggles. First stage should be <30s.

sam: Sampling policy: deterministic seeded sampler per model version + small stratified set to cover tok lengths 8/64/512.

mira: Agreed. Also want auto-fallback heuristics: if full exec fails but quick-check passes -> mark as 'degraded' and schedule manual review; don't auto-publish.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy for smokebridge-refactor branch started on int-env. ID: cb-2026-03-21-01

jordan: :thumbsup: Will instrument telemetry metrics: per-model failure reason, kv_mismatch, quantized_incompat, runtime_crash.

lee: One more: artifact packaging. Include a minimal runtime manifest to declare ops we expect (e.g., rotary, fused_attention). That reduces 'unknown-op' surprises at runtime.

sam: Op manifest can be schema v1.0. But make it optional fallback to on-the-fly op mapping with warning.

mira: Next steps: I'll open RFC PR with interface + example runner. Sam/Jordan/Lee can review quick-check latency budget and ops manifest shape. Meeting Thurs @10?

sam: On it. I'll draft sampler stratification doc.

jordan: I'll wire up the telemetry and add kv mismatch error codes.

lee: I'll mock the sandbox isolation plan.

mira: :rocket: thanks. If anyone sees risk I'm missing ping here.

deploy-bot: Canary completed: 5/5 smokebridge jobs passed on int-env. Metrics: avg quick-check 18s, full exec 2m12s.

sam: We should add a --skip-quantized flag for the quick-check so folks can fast-validate float artifacts without waiting on quantized pipelines.

jordan: Agree, and emit a warning code so QA can triage quantization-only failures separately.

lee: I'll add a short runbook snippet for when kv_cache_expected exceeds node limits (auto-fail vs queue).

mira: Perfect. RFC PR incoming in a few hours. Thanks all.
